new: Chromium updated from 155 to 157, with every security fix since (listed below).
BrowseCraft is now built straight from Chromium's own release, with ungoogled-chromium's core changes, the same way on Windows and Linux.
The installer's About link points at the AltCraft site.
fixed: The Linux version is built without developer debug checks, as Windows always has been.
Still no ungoogled-chromium first-run page on first start.
